meta.mission: MISSION-R-05 (J-037 / V1CAP-067) continuous domain-neutrality CI guard
meta.provenance: Tokens derived from STREAM_I_CONTAMINATION_AUDIT.json (34 findings) and the P33 kernel-purity DOMAIN_TERMS. Every entry was OBSERVED by the guard against the live tree on the generation date; entries carry the observed file, kind, token, occurrence count and line numbers. streamIRef maps each entry back to its STREAM I finding (or STREAM H domainContaminationInCode entry) where one exists.
meta.scope: frontend/src/lib/*.ts (universal lib ROOT files only — kernel/ purity is owned by tests/unit/kernel-purity.test.ts), frontend/src/lib/kernel/phase-contracts/ (NOT covered by the kernel-purity test), database/supabase/migrations/*.sql
meta.ratchetPolicy: SHRINK-ONLY RATCHET (ADR-003/004 coordination): entries may be REMOVED as relocations land — they may NEVER be added. The guard fails on any observed (kind, file, token) violation group not present in this list and warns (never silently passes) on every entry it does contain, printing each quarantined hit on every run. To clear an entry, relocate the domain code into the owning runtime namespace, then delete the entry in the same change.

semantics.fail: observed violation group absent from baselineEntries
semantics.warn: observed violation group present in baselineEntries (printed every run)
semantics.ratchet: baseline entry no longer observed — removable by the engineer who cleared it
